title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in English, Part 2 (CEFR A0–A1)
dek: Part 2 of the ultimate beginner guide to high-frequency English verbs (A0–A1): do/make, speak/talk/say/tell, look/watch/see, listen/hear, must/have to, take/give/get, live, wait, understand, and ask/answer.

blocks.text: Welcome to Part 2 of our English verb guide for A0–A1 learners! In this edition, we explore 10 vital action, perception, modality, and communication verb pairs and clusters with rich phrase examples.

items:
**1. Do / Make:** Activity vs Creation.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I do my homework' vs 'I make breakfast'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'do business', 'do research' | 'make progress', 'make a mistake'.

**2. Speak / Talk / Say / Tell:** Communication nuances.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I speak English', 'Let's talk about it', 'Say hello to her', 'Tell me the truth'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'speak fluently', 'talk with', 'say yes', 'tell a story'.

**3. Look / Watch / See:** Visual perception & attention.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Look at this picture', 'Watch a movie', 'I see a bird outside'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'look for', 'look forward to', 'watch out', 'see you soon'.

**4. Listen / Hear:** Auditory focus vs involuntary perception.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Listen to music', 'Did you hear that noise?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'listen carefully', 'hear from', 'glad to hear that'.

**5. Must / Have To:** Expressing necessity & obligation.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I must study for the exam', 'We have to leave now'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'must be', 'have to go', 'don't have to'.

**6. Take / Give / Get:** Physical and abstract exchange.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Take a coat', 'Give me a hand', 'Get a gift / Get home'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'take care', 'give up', 'get tired', 'get ready'.

**7. Live:** Dwelling, existence, and lifestyle.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I live in London', 'She lives with her family'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'live abroad', 'live well', 'live together'.

**8. Wait:** Patience, expectation, and time.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Wait for the bus', 'Can you wait a minute?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'wait for', 'wait in line', 'can't wait'.

**9. Understand:** Comprehension and active listening.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I understand the lesson', 'Do you understand what I mean?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'make yourself understood', 'as I understand', 'fully understand'.

**10. Ask / Answer:** Questions and responses.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'Ask a question', 'Answer the phone / email'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'ask for help', 'answer questions', 'ask a favour'.
